name: Gesto
title: Warehouse Chief

villagemaster/30511.htm.text: Warehouse Chief Gesto: I am Warehouse Chief Gesto of the Iron Gate Guild here in Giran. Our motto is "We sell anything to anyone, anywhere." We travel to frozen wastes, deserts, even volcanic zones, to create prosperity for our Dwarven tribe. Who else can claim that? But you're a new face around he…

links.text: Listen to information about second class transfer.

Q00040_ASpecialOrder/30511-01.html.text: Warehouse Chief Gesto: Why are you here?

links.text: "I came to get the seed jar Miss Helvetia ordered."

Q00040_ASpecialOrder/30511-05.html.text: Warehouse Chief Gesto: Thank you. Now to carefully put the seeds you brought into this jar... Finished! Now deliver this seed jar to Miss Helvetia . Hurry so you don't get scolded for being late!

Q00040_ASpecialOrder/30511-04.html.text: Warehouse Chief Gesto: Did you get all the seeds I asked for? I need 40 from each of the following: Thorn Cobol, Golden Cobol and Great Cobol . I'm counting on you!

Q00040_ASpecialOrder/30511-06.html.text: Warehouse Chief Gesto: Deliver this seed jar to Miss Helvetia . Hurry so you don't get scolded for being late!

Q00040_ASpecialOrder/30511-02.html.text: Warehouse Chief Gesto: Seed jar! Oh my, I completely forgot about it! It's late! Would you help me? Since you'll have to wait for it anyway, it'll be faster if you help me.

Q00040_ASpecialOrder/30511-03.html.text: Warehouse Chief Gesto: You can bring me some of the crops she ordered. I need 40 crops from each of the following: the Thorn Cobol, Golden Cobol and Great Cobol . Go to the Manor Manager and get the crops. I'm counting on you -- for both our sakes!
